ideas.idea: Add missing /img/reception.jpg and an Eleventy passthrough copy so the homepage image doesn't 404
ideas.why: Accurate: no img folder or passthrough exists, so the image on the homepage is broken.

ideas.idea: Enrich Dentist JSON-LD with address, openingHours and url
ideas.why: The JSON-LD has only name and telephone, while the address is already visible on the page.

ideas.idea: List actual prices on Services since it claims prices are simple and clear
ideas.why: The page claims clear prices but shows none, so users and machines get no price information.

ideas.idea: Give each treatment its own page
ideas.why: This is plausible content strategy but speculative for a four-item list and not tied to a specific defect.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists with qualifications and registration details on Team
ideas.why: The Team page has only a vague claim and no names, so adding them gives real, checkable content.

ideas.idea: Back up 'Trusted by thousands of local patients' with reviews or a source
ideas.why: The homepage claim is unsupported, and a source would make it verifiable.

ideas.idea: Add opening hours and emergency contact details as text on Contact
ideas.why: Contact has only a phone number and address, while the homepage promises emergency appointments.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to sitemap entries or generate the sitemap from collections
ideas.why: This is accurate, but lastmod has little effect on a four-page hand-kept sitemap.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/WebSite structured data and og: social tags
ideas.why: This applies to almost any site and has little effect on a small local business site.

ideas.idea: Link onward from the home page to Team and Contact
ideas.why: The nav already links to both pages on every page, so extra homepage links add little.
Accurate, since no 404 exists, but it's a standard suggestion with little effect on discoverability.
